reason: I'd probably run the free trial because I run every tool on a trial, but the charge lands at day 7 and by then I'd have maybe 70 DMs out and no real reply data, so I'd cancel like I do with most of them. No customer results yet, and it sends from my own Instagram, so I'm not putting my main account at risk for a $147 bet on an unproven tool.
objection: Will this get my Instagram restricted or banned? A refund for the month doesn't bring back an account with my clients' DMs and my own content on it, and there are no results from real users yet to show it works.
would_change_my_mind: Two or three founding members in my niche showing real reply and booked-call numbers from a few weeks of sending, plus a clear statement of what pace counts as the safe default.
